biotools.summary: PathwayNexus is an open-source add-on for VANTED that helps researchers analyze large metabolomics datasets by mapping them onto pathways and offering functionalities like ranking, sorting, and clustering. It is designed to condense pathways into more relevant subsets aligned with user interests.
